payload.title: [cli] frick init scaffolds the deleted @fricken/server (broken app)
payload.description: Post-cutover, frick init's TS scaffold still pins @fricken/server: workspace:* and src/server.ts imports createFrickServer from it, so the scaffolded app cannot install/run. Reworking the template to drop the deleted dep: server.ts becomes a schema+projection-registry module (keeps the projection markers so scaffold projection still works), smoke.test validates the schema instead of booting a server, and a README points at the standalone frick-server binary. In progress via the fix-cutover-bugs workflow.
